protocol: One completed chamber flight per completer. Planned 150 min of pure oxygen before ascent, including cycling and light exercise. Seated flight with a 45,000-ft nominal peak and stepped descent with controlled oxygen flow.
outcome_window: In-flight and one-hour postflight staff observation. Reported no signs or symptoms through 24 hours under participant-initiated reporting after release.
locator: Methods p. 6, Results p. 20 and DCS surveillance p. 32 (PDF pp. 13, 27 and 39)
note: Twelve completed profiles, distinct from 16 attempts and 14 recruited people. Four aborted attempts and observer exposures are outside this denominator. Ascertainment is source-defined and delayed reporting is passive.

protocol: Four men, 120 min of 100% oxygen before the high-altitude flight. Staged ascent and stepwise descent from 40,000 ft during the passenger mask test.
outcome_window: During altitude exposure. A postexposure clinic evaluation and instructions for reporting delayed symptoms are described. A delayed outcome count is unavailable.
locator: Participants and Methods, Discussion p. 10 (PDF p. 11)
note: The paper gives four subjects and explicitly states no symptoms during altitude exposure. The counting unit is people. No delayed event-free follow-up was imputed.
